# webtables/alloc

> Helper: the heap. `$__pk_alloc(n)` returns `n` zeroed bytes, 8-aligned.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/alloc.pkg)

A bump allocator at the end of linear memory, which grows with
`memory.grow` by at least 64 MB at a time; new memory is zeroed. Memory
is never freed. Running out calls `$__pk_panic_oom`. `$__pk_str(n)`
allocates a string of `n` bytes: the length word, the bytes and a 0.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
@panic
```

Includes: [webtables/panic](panic.md)

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
(global $__pk_heap (mut i64) (i64.const 8454144))
(global $__pk_heap_end (mut i64) (i64.const 8519680))
(func $__pk_alloc (param $n i64) (result i64) (local $r i64) (local $grow i64)
(local.set $n (i64.and (i64.add (local.get $n) (i64.const 7)) (i64.const -8)))
(if (i64.gt_u (i64.add (global.get $__pk_heap) (local.get $n)) (global.get $__pk_heap_end)) (then
(local.set $grow (i64.and (i64.add (select (local.get $n) (i64.const 67108864) (i64.gt_u (local.get $n) (i64.const 67108864))) (i64.const 65535)) (i64.const -65536)))
(if (i32.lt_s (memory.grow (i32.wrap_i64 (i64.shr_u (local.get $grow) (i64.const 16)))) (i32.const 0)) (then (call $__pk_panic_oom)))
(global.set $__pk_heap_end (i64.add (global.get $__pk_heap_end) (local.get $grow)))))
(local.set $r (global.get $__pk_heap))
(global.set $__pk_heap (i64.add (local.get $r) (local.get $n)))
(local.get $r))
(func $__pk_str (param $n i64) (result i64) (local $s i64)
(local.set $s (call $__pk_alloc (i64.add (local.get $n) (i64.const 9))))
(i64.store (i32.wrap_i64 (local.get $s)) (local.get $n))
(local.get $s))
```
